description: This file defines an Android IntentService called CalendarQueryService that queries calendar events within a specified time range, retrieves associated contact profile pictures, and sends the event data via the Wearable DataApi to connected wearable devices. It manages GoogleApiClient connections, processes calendar and contact data, formats it into DataItems, and uses Android and Google Play Services APIs extensively.

classes.name: CalendarQueryService
classes.description: An IntentService that queries calendar events, retrieves contact profile pictures, and sends this data to wearable devices via the DataApi.

classes.name: CalendarQueryService.Event
classes.description: A nested class representing a calendar event with methods to convert it into a DataMapRequest for sending over the wearable data layer.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the GoogleApiClient for connecting to Google Play Services and the Wearable API.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Main method that connects to GoogleApiClient, queries upcoming calendar events, and sends them via DataApi.

methods.name: queryEvents
methods.description: Queries calendar events within a time window and retrieves associated contact profile pictures.

methods.name: toPutDataMapRequest
methods.description: Converts an Event object into a PutDataMapRequest for transmission.
